Running Python code interactively: with open('/workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/openthread/tests/fuzz/corpora/radio-receive-done/mle-parent-request', 'rb') as f:
    data = f.read()

print(f"Length: {len(data)} bytes")
print(f"Hex: {data.hex()}")
print()

# 802.15.4 MAC frame header
# Frame control: 2 bytes
fc = int.from_bytes(data[0:2], 'little')
print(f"Frame Control: 0x{fc:04x}")
print(f"  Frame Type: {fc & 0x07}")  # 1 = Data
print(f"  Security Enabled: {(fc >> 3) & 1}")
print(f"  Frame Pending: {(fc >> 4) & 1}")
print(f"  Ack Request: {(fc >> 5) & 1}")
print(f"  PAN ID Compression: {(fc >> 6) & 1}")
print(f"  Dest Addr Mode: {(fc >> 10) & 3}")  # 2 = short, 3 = extended
print(f"  Frame Version: {(fc >> 12) & 3}")
print(f"  Src Addr Mode: {(fc >> 14) & 3}")  # 2 = short, 3 = extended

# Sequence number: 1 byte
seq = data[2]
print(f"\nSequence Number: {seq}")

# Dest PAN ID: 2 bytes
dst_pan = int.from_bytes(data[3:5], 'little')
print(f"Dest PAN ID: 0x{dst_pan:04x}")

# Dest Addr: depends on mode (2=short, 3=extended)
dst_mode = (fc >> 10) & 3
offset = 5
if dst_mode == 2:
    dst_addr = data[offset:offset+2]
    offset += 2
    print(f"Dest Addr (short): {dst_addr.hex()}")
elif dst_mode == 3:
    dst_addr = data[offset:offset+8]
    offset += 8
    print(f"Dest Addr (ext): {dst_addr.hex()}")

# Source: PAN ID compression means no src PAN ID
pan_id_comp = (fc >> 6) & 1
if not pan_id_comp:
    src_pan = int.from_bytes(data[offset:offset+2], 'little')
    offset += 2
    print(f"Src PAN ID: 0x{src_pan:04x}")

src_mode = (fc >> 14) & 3
if src_mode == 2:
    src_addr = data[offset:offset+2]
    offset += 2
    print(f"Src Addr (short): {src_addr.hex()}")
elif src_mode == 3:
    src_addr = data[offset:offset+8]
    offset += 8
    print(f"Src Addr (ext): {src_addr.hex()}")

print(f"\nMAC header ends at offset: {offset}")
print(f"Remaining payload: {data[offset:].hex()}")
